A <c:ffff00>Leg Type<c> that swims on the surface, underwater
and at low altitude. Its <c:ffff00>{{stats}}<c> favor <c:ffff00>{{armor}}<c> and
<c:ffff00>{{mobility}}<c>. Built for water, it does poorly elsewhere.

<c:ffff00>{{terrain|cap}} {{affinity|cap}}<c> ({{mobility}}, <c:ffff00>{{fighting}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{shooting}}<c>):
  <c:ffff00>{{plains}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{forest}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{rocky_ground}}<c>: 0. <c:ffff00>{{waterside}}<c>,
  <c:ffff00>{{underwater}}<c>: +6.
  <c:ffff00>{{sand}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{tundra}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{hall}}<c>: -4. <c:ffff00>{{cyber}}<c>: +4.
  <c:ffff00>{{sky}}<c>: {{robattle|pl}} not possible.
